subject: Bug fix: reset io_last_written on c->buf resize to prevent stale pointers (#2786)
reason: Memory-safety fix in clientsCronResizeOutputBuffer: when the client reply buffer c->buf is reallocated by the server cron, a pending partial-write pointer (c->io_last_written.buf) that still referenced the freed old buffer is now repointed to the new buffer, avoiding a stale/dangling pointer that would trip serverAssert (networking.c:2711) or corrupt post-write bookkeeping.
